digest.component_or_area: Jira DC harness - Epic field readiness gate
propositions: The DC harness errors all 62 cells at fixture setup because wait_for_jira_dc_ready checks for Epic Link and Epic Name fields at session start, before any Jira Software project exists.

GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name only when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup, creating an ordering deadlock where the gate blocks the action that would provision the required fields.

Increasing the field readiness timeout budget does not resolve the issue; 600s and 1800s budgets both failed with identical field inventories and a container idle for ~29 minutes after Startup completed.
The fix relocates the Epic field check from session start (wait_for_jira_dc_ready) to after project provisioning (_assert_project_capabilities), where the fields can actually exist.
The probe script (jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py) has the same ordering bug: it awaits Epic fields before creating its project, causing it to fail since change 1387.
